title: Intracranial EEG from 9 adults during a memory-guided actions experiment (preprocessed epochs, Moraresku et al.)
description: Stereo-EEG recordings from nine patients with drug-resistant epilepsy performing a delayed memory-guided action task at the Motol Epilepsy Center in Prague. This derivative dataset re-packages the authors' preprocessed, bipolar-referenced epochs (512 Hz, time-locked to encoding onset) in BIDS format. It supports investigation of interactions between dorsal and ventral visual streams and the hippocampus during working memory and memory-guided actions.
methods_description: Stereo-EEG was recorded at 2048 Hz (Quantum, NeuroWorks) and downsampled to 512 Hz. A 50 Hz notch filter with harmonics was applied, faulty or epileptic contacts were removed, and bipolar referencing was used between adjacent contacts. Epochs ran from -2 to 7.898 s around encoding onset. In the task, participants encoded an object at one position, waited through a delay, then reached to the remembered position with a joystick. Stimuli were presented with PsychoPy3, and task and iEEG were synchronised by TTL pulses.
